lines.speaker: Mat
lines.text: Okay, let's start with the vendor. We looked at Acme and Northwind last week.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Northwind's support was better in the trial and the price difference was small.

lines.speaker: Mat
lines.text: Decision made, Northwind it is. Sam, can you own the contract follow-up with them by Friday?

lines.speaker: Mat
lines.text: Great, this is running long, let's move on to rollout.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: We should pilot with the field team first before the whole department.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Someone needs to draft the pilot checklist for the field team.

lines.speaker: Mat
lines.text: No, that one's Priya's. Priya, you draft the checklist.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Got it, I'll have the checklist ready next Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Mat
lines.text: Budget is already approved, so nothing to discuss there. That's a wrap, thanks everyone.
